subtasks: Place all the objects into the box with their front sides facing left.
Use the left gripper to move the upright box to the middle of the table and straighten its long edges left to right. Keep the toothbrush held up in the right gripper.
Place the held toothbrush lengthwise along the back inside edge of the box, with its small brush head on the left and its white handle on the right.
Use the left gripper to bring the upright box to the middle of the table, long edges left to right. Hold it steady until it rests. Keep the toothbrush held in the right gripper.
Place the held toothbrush inside the box, parallel to the long edges with its brush head on the left.
Pull the box toward the front middle of the table with the left gripper. Set it upright with its long edges horizontal, left to right. Leave the toothbrush inside.
Place the toy car lengthwise in the open box with the front grille pointing left and the rear pointing right. Put it in the free lane behind the toothbrush.
Use the left gripper to pull the box with the toothbrush toward the front center, underneath the car held high in the right gripper. Keep the box upright and its long sides aligned left to right.
Set the held toy car down inside the box with its grille facing left and all four wheels supported. Leave the toothbrush inside.
Pack the hammer lengthwise into the box with its metal head on the left and its handle on the right. Keep the car and toothbrush inside.

Pick up the red shoe with the left gripper and place it entirely inside the box, parallel to the long edges with toe left and heel right. Then open both grippers and return both arms to their initial poses.
